lines.title: jev-guard. A security hook for coding agents, powered by Jev.
lines.before: Before a tool runs, Jev scores the exact call. Routine commands pass silently. A force push needs your approval. Destructive commands are denied before they ever run — in about half a second, for a fraction of a cent.
lines.after: After a tool returns, the result is scanned for text aimed at AI agents. This job posting hides a canary. jev-guard flags it, and the agent treats it as untrusted data instead of following it.
lines.works: It works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cursor, pi, OpenCode, and any ACP editor.
lines.install: Install it from npm, add your Jev key, and hook it into your agent. jev-guard — on GitHub now.
